podcast.title: Laurel Canyon as a Root for 70s Rock
podcast.body: The "roots of 70s rock" are identified in the "folk can pop music that was made in Laurel Canyon in Southern California." This area fostered the development of singer-songwriters and harmony-driven sounds that became central to the decade's musical landscape. "The roots of 70s rock can be found in the full can pop music that was made in Laurel Canyon in Southern California."
